description: Every update waits for a dashboard tick, and the tick is the only gate: Renovate does not persist approvals, so a tick on a soak-blocked update is consumed and silently discarded, and this part sets no release-age soak. The non-major part lifts the tick and brings the soak back.

packageRules.description: Require explicit dashboard approval for all normal updates
Docker updates wait for a tick, digest pins included.
CI action updates wait for a tick, digest pins included.
The tick is the gate, so ticked update types carry no release-age soak; the non-major part restores it where it lifts the tick.
